name: Colorful Keynote System
tagline: Premium marketplace-style Keynote deck with colorful modular geometry, heavy black outlines, bright pitch blocks, portfolio grids, and crisp startup layouts.

palette.description: Warm off-white surface with black ink, purple, pink, yellow, cyan, and green marketplace-style accent geometry.

typography.style: Modern geometric display type with clean sans body copy and bold black-edged modules.

best_for: Agency pitches, startup overviews, creative business profiles, portfolio-heavy marketing decks, and colorful Keynote-style narratives.
avoid_for: Sober board reports, medical/legal materials, or dense financial tables where colorful marketplace energy would distract.

source_inspiration.name: GraphicRiver Colorful Pitch Deck and Keynote Marketplace Direction
source_inspiration.notes: Low-fidelity page-by-page HTML/CSS reconstruction inspired by the public GraphicRiver colorful pitch deck and Keynote marketplace direction: modular bright geometry, black outline structure, portfolio grids, color-block roadmap pages, and modern pitch sections. The source URL is a marketplace search/aggregation page rather than a single item with reliable per-slide previews, so this is not claimed as a clone of one specific source deck. No source assets are embedded.
